function solve(keys::Vector{String}, values::Vector{Int})
    result = []
    seen = Set{String}()
    for (k, v) in zip(keys, values)
        if !isempty(seen) && k ∉ seen
            continue
        end
        if k ∉ seen
            push!(seen, k)
            push!(result, Pair(k, v))
        else
            # Update the sum for the key if it was already seen
            for pair in result
                if pair.first == k
                    pair.second += v
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
